verses.text: On that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city. God makes salvation its walls and its defenses.
Open the gates, so that the righteous nation may enter, the nation that stays faithful.
You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds stay fixed on you, because they trust in you.
Trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD, the LORD himself, is the Rock that lasts forever.
He brings down those who live up high. He brings down the proud city. He brings it down to the ground. He throws it into the dust.
Feet trample it down, the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy."
The path of the righteous is level. You, the Upright One, make the way of the righteous smooth.
Yes, LORD, we wait for you as we walk in the way of your laws. Your name and your fame are what our hearts desire.
My soul longs for you in the night. Yes, my spirit inside me looks for you eagerly. For when your judgments come on the earth, the people of the world learn what is right.
Even when kindness is shown to the wicked, they do not learn what is right. Even in a land of honest people they keep doing evil, and they do not see the majesty of the LORD.
LORD, your hand is raised, but they do not see it. Let them see your burning love for your people and be ashamed. Let the fire saved for your enemies burn them up.
LORD, you give us peace. Everything we have done, you have done for us.
LORD our God, other masters besides you have ruled over us, but your name alone is the one we honor.
Those masters are dead. They will not live again. Their spirits will not rise. You punished them and destroyed them, and wiped out all memory of them.
You have made the nation grow, LORD. You have made the nation grow! You have shown your glory. You have pushed back all the borders of the land.
LORD, they came to you in their trouble. When you disciplined them, they could only whisper a prayer.
Like a pregnant woman about to give birth, who twists in pain and cries out, so were we because of you, LORD.
We were pregnant. We twisted in pain, but we gave birth only to wind. We have not brought salvation to the earth, and no new people have been born into the world.
But your dead will live. Their bodies will rise again. You who live in the dust, wake up and shout for joy! For your dew is like the morning dew, and the earth will give birth to its dead.
Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut the doors behind you. Hide yourselves for a little while, until God's anger has passed.
For look, the LORD is coming out of his place to punish the people of the earth for their sins. The earth will uncover the blood spilled on it. It will no longer hide those who were killed.
